integrity: The claim was reconstructed from the defining conditions, compared directly with the 2016 full text, and replayed by a standalone exhaustive checker through order 10. Finite verification is not used as a substitute for the proof.
scientific_limitations: Complete multipartite graphs only; the infinite proof uses their induced-subgraph connectivity structure. A targeted search found no later published endpoint correction, but poorly indexed terminology remains a residual bibliographic risk.
title: Total outer-component domination of complete multipartite graphs with a corrected bipartite boundary
